outcome: Prevalence of disrespect and abuse during childbirth
cohort: 281 women who gave birth in public health institutions in Arba Minch town, south Ethiopia, between January 01 and February 28, 2017
finding: The prevalence of disrespectful care during childbirth was 98.9%, with violations of the right to information and informed consent being the most common (92.5%).
mod_finding: Giving birth by cesarean section was significantly associated with specific women's rights violations.
